steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); })()

steps.name: place-row
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = [ ['sofa-3seat',{}], ['sofa-lshape',{}], ['dining-chair',{}], ['office-chair',{style:'executive'}], ['bar-stool',{}], ['bar-stool',{style:'pedestal'}], ['bench',{}], ['armchair',{style:'wingback'}], ['armchair',{style:'tub'}], ['ottoman',{}], ['chaise-lounge',{}], ['dining-table-4',{}], ['dining-table-4',{shape:'round'}], ['dining-table-4',{shape:'oval',seats:'6'}], ['desk',{legStyle:'hairpin'}], ['coffee-table',{shape:'round'}], ['console-table',{style:'drawers'}], ['bar-cart',{tiers:3}], ['side-table',{}], ['side-table',{shape:'drum'}] ]; const dz = 2.6, x = 10.5, z0 = 2.0; const pos = {}; const list = items.map(([defId, props], i) => { const z = z0 + i * dz; const key = defId + ':' + JSON.stringify(props); pos[key] = [x, z]; return { id: 'audit-' + i, defId, position: [x, z], rotation: Math.PI, props }; }); window.__auditPos = pos; s.setItems(list); return list.length; })()

steps.name: frame-sofa
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['sofa-3seat:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.45, p[1]], radius: 1.6 }); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['bar-stool:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.4, p[1] + 1.3], radius: 1.4 }); })()
